item.title: 8 Places to See in Interlaken, Switzerland (Jungfraujoch, Waterfalls and Lakes)
item.description: Interlaken sits between two turquoise lakes at the foot of the Jungfrau region. Ride up to Jungfraujoch, Europe's highest railway station at 3,454 m, or walk the Lauterbrunnen valley of 72 waterfalls. All 8, plus the best time to go, in the guide. Save this pin for your trip.
